title.hi: झील से पहले के दो जीवन

logline: After the rescue, Hūhū regains his Gandharva form. The narrator reveals how Devala's curse led him to the crocodile body and how King Indradyumna, cursed by Agastya while absorbed in worship, became Gajendra.

source.edition: Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam Canto 8 Chapter 4 original child-friendly Telugu/Hindi/English retelling; no copied published translation
source.verification_notes: Verses 8.4.3–4 explicitly describe crocodile Hūhū regaining Gandharva form and honoring Hari, after Devala cursed him; chapter overview provides the background that Huhu pulled Devala's leg during a water prank, sought forgiveness and was granted eventual release. Exact prank blocking is noted original dramatization rather than a new verse quotation. Verse 8.4.5 records restored Huhu's departure, which is reserved for E06/S02. Verses 7–8 identify devout Pāṇḍya king Indradyumna and his Malaya Hills hermitage/quiet vow; 8.4.9–10 Agastya arrives with pupils, receives no greeting and curses him to become an elephant; 8.4.11–12 the king accepts fate and later remembers devotion by grace. Gajendra's four-armed spiritual liberation is at 8.4.6 and is reserved for E06. We preserve original distinct Devala/Huhu vs Agastya/Indradyumna pairings. S01: SB 8.4.3-4; Huhu-Devala chapter-summary flashbacks explicitly disclosed as original dramatization rather than verse invention. S02: SB 8.4.3-4; Huhu-Devala chapter-summary flashbacks explicitly disclosed as original dramatization rather than verse invention. S03: SB 8.4.3-4; Huhu-Devala chapter-summary flashbacks explicitly disclosed as original dramatization rather than verse invention. S04: source SB 8.4.7, 8.4.8; original adaptation staging explicitly distinguished from cited verse actions. S05: source SB 8.4.9, 8.4.10; original adaptation staging explicitly distinguished from cited verse actions.

core_preserved: Hūhū's crocodile existence ended in the Lord's rescue; Devala's curse is broken as he regains original Gandharva form (8.4.3–4).
Hūhū honors the Lord, but the exact aftermath departure is reserved to E06 (8.4.5).
The chapter overview recounts the incident involving Hūhū, sage Devala and a playful pull on the sage's leg in water; this is a backstory, not a new event at Gajendra's lake.
King Indradyumna of Pāṇḍya/Draviḍa was a devout Vaiṣṇava who retired to the Malaya Hills and observed a silent vow in worship (8.4.7–8).
Agastya visited with disciples, interpreted silence as disrespect, cursed Indradyumna to an elephant body (8.4.9–10).
The king accepted the curse, and due to devotion remembered prayer in the elephant life (8.4.11–12).

S04: The narrator identifies Gajendra's earlier life as devout Pāṇḍya king Indradyumna. He retires from royal life to a small Malaya Hills hermitage, wearing matted locks and absorbed in silent worship of Hari (8.4.7–8).

S05: Agastya visits while King Indradyumna is deeply absorbed in worship and observing silence, receives no formal welcome and becomes angry. He pronounces a curse that the king should take an elephant body (8.4.9–10), without equating silence with deliberate cruelty.
changes: Episode 5's flashbacks are editorial retelling of earlier lives AFTER the rescue; no crocodile appears alive in the present lake after its animal life ends.
Hūhū and Devala's former water interaction is separate in time/place from Gajendra's lake attack; original shot continuity with no manufactured companions or human speech.
The camera's visual storytelling and Huhu's reaction/movements are original staging, never claimed as specific verse wording.
Indradyumna's silent vow does not justify portraying him as evil or Agastya as a grotesque monster.
The spiritual final Gajendra four-armed form appears in E06, not during the narrated curse flashback. Characters remain identical to owner-approved nine-panel art.
S01: flashback camera and narrative background separated from exact verse statements, no invented character dialogue.
S02: flashback camera and narrative background separated from exact verse statements, no invented character dialogue.
S03: flashback camera and narrative background separated from exact verse statements, no invented character dialogue.
adaptation.fidelity_note: Source-checked SB 8.4.3–12 and the chapter's historical summary. All scripture paraphrases are newly worded, and details only in the chapter's prose overview or invented camera staging are explicitly disclosed as original dramatization. The two curses remain historically distinct.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The crocodile had once been a Gandharva.

text.te: ఆ మొసలి పూర్వజన్మలో ఒక గంధర్వుడు.
text.hi: वह मगरमच्छ पहले एक गंधर्व था।
text.en: The crocodile had once been a Gandharva.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: His name was Huhu.

text.te: అతని పేరు హూహూ.
text.hi: उसका नाम हूहू था।
text.en: His name was Huhu.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He had been a king among the Gandharvas.

text.te: అతను గంధర్వులలో ఒక రాజు.
text.hi: वह गंधर्वों में एक राजा था।
text.en: He had been a king among the Gandharvas.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Sage Devala's curse had given him crocodile form.

text.te: దేవల మహర్షి శాపం వల్ల అతనికి మొసలి రూపం వచ్చింది.
text.hi: देवल ऋषि के श्राप से वह मगरमच्छ बना था।
text.en: Sage Devala's curse had given him crocodile form.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: By Narayana's mercy, the curse was lifted.

text.te: నారాయణుడి కృపతో ఆ శాపం తొలగిపోయింది.
text.hi: नारायण की कृपा से वह श्राप समाप्त हुआ।
text.en: By Narayana's mercy, the curse was lifted.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Huhu regained his original Gandharva form.

text.te: హూహూ తన అసలు గంధర్వ రూపాన్ని తిరిగి పొందాడు.
text.hi: हूहू को अपना असली गंधर्व रूप वापस मिला।
text.en: Huhu regained his original Gandharva form.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He stood respectfully near the lake.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడి సరస్సు దగ్గర అతను భక్తితో నిలిచాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र की झील के पास वह श्रद्धा से खड़ा हुआ।
text.en: He stood respectfully near the lake.

source_attribution.note: Original simple blocking of restored Huhu beside the established lake during his source-described honor to Hari. SB 8.4.3-4 does not define this precise standing position or camera.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He bowed his head to Hari.

text.te: హరికి తల వంచి నమస్కరించాడు.
text.hi: उसने हरि को सिर झुकाकर प्रणाम किया।
text.en: He bowed his head to Hari.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Long ago, Huhu lived in Gandharvaloka.

text.te: హూహూ గంధర్వ లోకంలో జీవించేవాడు.
text.hi: हूहू गंधर्व लोक में रहता था।
text.en: Long ago, Huhu lived in Gandharvaloka.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: One day he was enjoying himself in the water.

text.te: ఒకసారి అతను నీళ్లలో సరదాగా ఆడుకుంటున్నాడు.
text.hi: एक दिन वह पानी में खेल रहा था।
text.en: One day he was enjoying himself in the water.

No invented direct character dialogue.

text.hi: उसी समय देवल ऋषि वहाँ स्नान कर रहे थे।
text.en: Sage Devala was bathing nearby.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The sage became angry at Huhu's action.

text.te: హూహూ చేసిన పని వల్ల మహర్షికి కోపం వచ్చింది.
text.hi: हूहू की इस हरकत पर ऋषि क्रोधित हो गए।
text.en: The sage became angry at Huhu's action.

source_attribution.note: Original child-friendly flashback narration and blocking derived from the SB 8.4 chapter overview describing Huhu's water prank toward Devala; numbered verses 8.4.3-4 establish the curse and later Gandharva restoration but do not independently give this exact action or moral wording. No invented direct character dialogue.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: That incident changed Huhu's life.

text.te: ఆ సంఘటన అతని జీవితాన్ని మార్చేసింది.
text.hi: उस घटना ने हूहू का जीवन बदल दिया।
text.en: That incident changed Huhu's life.

source_attribution.note: Original child-friendly flashback narration and blocking derived from the SB 8.4 chapter overview describing Huhu's water prank toward Devala; numbered verses 8.4.3-4 establish the curse and later Gandharva restoration but do not independently give this exact action or moral wording. No invented direct character dialogue.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Sage Devala cursed Huhu.

text.te: దేవల మహర్షి హూహూకు శాపం ఇచ్చారు.
text.hi: देवल ऋषि ने हूहू को श्राप दिया।
text.en: Sage Devala cursed Huhu.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Because of that curse, he was born as a crocodile.

text.te: ఆ శాపం వల్ల అతను మొసలి రూపంలో జన్మించాడు.
text.hi: उस श्राप से वह मगरमच्छ के रूप में जन्मा।
text.en: Because of that curse, he was born as a crocodile.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Huhu understood his mistake and asked forgiveness.

text.te: తన తప్పు తెలిసిన హూహూ క్షమించమని కోరాడు.
text.hi: गलती समझकर हूहू ने क्षमा माँगी।
text.en: Huhu understood his mistake and asked forgiveness.

source_attribution.note: The chapter introduction for SB 8.4 recounts Huhu's regret and plea for forgiveness, beyond the text of numbered verses 3–4; narratorial staging/idiom is original.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: In compassion, Devala gave him hope.

text.te: దేవల మహర్షి కరుణతో అతనికి ఆశ ఇచ్చారు.
text.hi: देवल ऋषि ने करुणा से उसे आशा दी।
text.en: In compassion, Devala gave him hope.

source_attribution.note: The chapter overview says Devala gave compassionate reassurance of eventual release; original accessible paraphrase not itself a separately quoted verse 3–4.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He would one day be freed through the Lord's mercy.

text.te: భగవంతుడి కృపతో ఒక రోజు శాపం తొలగుతుందని చెప్పారు.
text.hi: उन्होंने बताया कि एक दिन भगवान की कृपा से श्राप दूर होगा।
text.en: He would one day be freed through the Lord's mercy.

source_attribution.note: The chapter overview specifies release when Gajendra was delivered; presented as an original retelling of background, not an independent numbered verse statement.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Much later, that crocodile caught Gajendra.

text.te: ఎన్నో రోజుల తరువాత ఆ మొసలి గజేంద్రుడిని పట్టుకుంది.
text.hi: बहुत समय बाद वही मगरमच्छ गजेन्द्र को पकड़ बैठा।
text.en: Much later, that crocodile caught Gajendra.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narayana's rescue restored Huhu's original form.

text.te: నారాయణుడి రక్షణతో హూహూ తన అసలు రూపాన్ని తిరిగి పొందాడు.
text.hi: नारायण के उद्धार से हूहू ने अपना मूल रूप पाया।
text.en: Narayana's rescue restored Huhu's original form.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Thus this curse ended in deliverance.

text.te: అలా ఆ శాప కథకు విముక్తి వచ్చింది.
text.hi: इस प्रकार उस श्राप की कथा का अंत मुक्ति में हुआ।
text.en: Thus this curse ended in deliverance.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra too had a story from an earlier life.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడికి ఇంకొక పూర్వజన్మ కథ కూడా ఉంది.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र की भी एक पिछली जन्म की कथा थी।
text.en: Gajendra too had a story from an earlier life.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: In that life he was called Indradyumna.

text.te: అప్పుడు అతని పేరు ఇంద్రద్యుమ్నుడు.
text.hi: तब उसका नाम इन्द्रद्युम्न था।
text.en: In that life he was called Indradyumna.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He was a king of the Pandya country in South India.

text.te: అతను దక్షిణ భారతంలోని పాండ్య దేశానికి రాజు.
text.hi: वह दक्षिण भारत के पाण्ड्य देश का राजा था।
text.en: He was a king of the Pandya country in South India.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Indradyumna was devoted to Lord Vishnu.

text.te: ఇంద్రద్యుమ్నుడు విష్ణుభక్తుడు.
text.hi: इन्द्रद्युम्न भगवान विष्णु के भक्त थे।
text.en: Indradyumna was devoted to Lord Vishnu.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He left royal life and went to the Malaya Hills.

text.te: ఒకప్పుడు రాజ్య జీవితాన్ని విడిచి మలయ పర్వతాలకు వెళ్లాడు.
text.hi: कुछ समय बाद वह राजजीवन छोड़कर मलय पर्वतों में चले गए।
text.en: He left royal life and went to the Malaya Hills.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: There he lived in a small hermitage.

text.te: అక్కడ చిన్న ఆశ్రమంలో నివసించాడు.
text.hi: वहाँ वह एक छोटी कुटिया में रहने लगे।
text.en: There he lived in a small hermitage.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: With matted hair and a simple life, he worshiped the Lord.

text.te: జటలతో, నిరాడంబరంగా భగవంతుని ఆరాధించాడు.
text.hi: जटाधारी होकर सादगी से भगवान की पूजा करने लगे।
text.en: With matted hair and a simple life, he worshiped the Lord.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: One day, during a vow of silence, he meditated deeply.

text.te: ఒక రోజు మౌనవ్రతంతో ఎంతో ఏకాగ్రంగా ధ్యానించాడు.
text.hi: एक दिन मौन व्रत में वह गहरे ध्यान में लीन थे।
text.en: One day, during a vow of silence, he meditated deeply.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Then Sage Agastya arrived with his disciples.

text.te: అప్పుడు అగస్త్య మహర్షి తన శిష్యులతో అక్కడికి వచ్చారు.
text.hi: उसी समय अगस्त्य ऋषि अपने शिष्यों के साथ वहाँ आए।
text.en: Then Sage Agastya arrived with his disciples.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Indradyumna was absorbed in meditation.

text.te: ఇంద్రద్యుమ్నుడు గాఢ ధ్యానంలో ఉన్నాడు.
text.hi: इन्द्रद्युम्न गहरे ध्यान में थे।
text.en: Indradyumna was absorbed in meditation.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Because he remained silent, he did not greet them.

text.te: మౌనవ్రతం వల్ల అతను వారిని పలకరించలేదు.
text.hi: मौन व्रत के कारण उसने उनका स्वागत नहीं किया।
text.en: Because he remained silent, he did not greet them.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The sage did not receive the customary welcome.

text.te: మహర్షికి తగిన స్వాగతం లభించలేదు.
text.hi: ऋषि को उचित आदर-सत्कार नहीं मिला।
text.en: The sage did not receive the customary welcome.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Agastya took this as disrespect and became angry.

text.te: దీన్ని అవమానంగా భావించి అగస్త్యుడికి కోపం వచ్చింది.
text.hi: इसे अपमान समझकर अगस्त्य क्रोधित हो गए।
text.en: Agastya took this as disrespect and became angry.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: In anger he pronounced a curse on Indradyumna.

text.te: ఆ కోపంతో ఇంద్రద్యుమ్నుడికి శాపం ఇచ్చారు.
text.hi: क्रोध में उन्होंने इन्द्रद्युम्न को श्राप दिया।
text.en: In anger he pronounced a curse on Indradyumna.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The curse was that he would take the body of an elephant.

text.te: తరువాతి జన్మలో ఏనుగు రూపం పొందాలని ఆ శాపం.
text.hi: श्राप था कि अगले जन्म में वह हाथी बने।
text.en: The curse was that he would take the body of an elephant.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: That moment changed the course of Indradyumna's life.

text.te: అది ఇంద్రద్యుమ్నుడి జీవితాన్ని మార్చిన ఘట్టం.
text.hi: यह घटना इन्द्रद्युम्न के जीवन को बदलने वाली थी।
text.en: That moment changed the course of Indradyumna's life.

source_attribution.note: Original gentle closing observation for the scriptural Agastya curse of 8.4.10; narrator calls it a turning point, not an additional distinct incident.
